message: applied: Standard held at $11 a month: $0.21 so far this month. Moved this month: 79,646 events to Flex, about $0 a month of Flex storage at $0.05 per million (Flex compute is unpriced and left out), $0.14 at the Standard rate. The Receiver's other services may send 20,570 events an hour to Standard against 32,447 now: each statement keeps up to 1,285 an hour, and the noisiest move to Flex first. A service the run has not seen gets the same level and the median service's 617 an hour until the next run, which takes any overshoot back from the rest of the month.
